variants.prompt: On the sun-kissed deck of a sleek, white yacht, the dreamy beauty reclines on a wicker chaise, her porcelain skin glowing against the rich, navy-blue fabric. The character's raven locks are swept up into a messy, seductive bun, with a few loose strands framing her luminous, emerald eyes. A barely-there, red bikini clings to her curves, the delicate lace of the bandeau grazing the swell of her breasts. Gold, hoop earrings dangle from her ears, and a wide, leather belt cinches at her narrow waist. The warm sunlight and ocean breeze ruffle her long, tanned legs, while her dainty, strappy sandals rest on the polished teak deck. A DSLR camera, angled from slightly above, captures her in a dynamic, full-body shot, the blurred sea and sky providing a stunning backdrop.
